summary: Iteration 9 — full validation of trust-score calibration + community Scam Wall signal integration. Backend: 9/9 new calibration tests PASS in 100s (real Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls) + 15/15 email-verification regression PASS. Frontend: /legitimacy page loads, form submits, report renders with the new `data-testid=score-methodology` <details> element, all 5 calibration bands (0–25, 25–45, 45–60, 60–75, 75–100) are visible when expanded, and the firsthand/Scam Wall note is present. Regression endpoints: /api/scams=24, /api/techniques=8, cache reuse hits <2s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines 1918-1940 — the new 5-band SCORING CALIBRATION prompt with the explicit '55 not 42' default line is well-crafted and empirically produces the expected behavior: Chanced (unknown crypto sweepstakes) now scores in the 50-65 range with 'Insufficient Information'/'Caution Advised' verdict, and the fully-fabricated ZZZ9999FakeCasino also lands >=40. Verified in live Claude calls.

server.py lines 1905-1916 — the wall_count query uses `{'$regex': f'^{re.escape(req.casino_name)}$', '$options': 'i'}` which is properly anchored + case-insensitive + escaped. Direct mongo probe confirms 'bovada', 'Bovada', 'BOVADA', 'BoVaDa' all return the same count (1 for the seeded Bovada post).
server.py line 1949-1954 — the Community Scam Wall signal is correctly injected into the Claude prompt as an explicit line, so the LLM can incorporate the community concern.

Frontend Legitimacy.jsx lines 122-141 — the score-methodology <details> element is well-scoped: initially closed (open=null), toggles on summary click (open=''), renders all 5 bands in a responsive grid, and the firsthand/Scam Wall calibration note is present. data-testid is properly set.

One thing worth noting for future scoring stability: Claude's Chanced score was 60 in this run — but it may return 50-65 across calls due to stochasticity. Our assertion floor is 50 which matches the specified >=50 threshold, but any future band tightening should include a wider test tolerance.
Note (carryover from iter 8): server.py is still ~2885 lines — splitting into routers still overdue but not blocking.

Bovada test observation: only 1 seeded scam_post for Bovada (not 3+ as review_request implies). The wall_signal for 1 post evaluates to 'worth reviewing' (mild concern), not 'ELEVATED CONCERN'. The elevated-concern branch (>=3) is code-covered by inspection but not by data. If the intent was to prove the elevated-concern message flows through, main agent may want to seed 2 more Bovada posts. Signal composition itself is correct per unit test.
